home.slogan: Write what you imagine, and beyond.
home.subtitle: A local-first AI short-form screenplay workbench: move from outline to scenes and shot cards with an agent.
home.newProjectDesc: Create a short-form screenplay template. Everything is saved locally as Markdown files.

home.importProjectDesc: Import never rewrites files. Unrecognized Markdown is marked for proposal-based organization in the workbench.
home.createModeHint: Start with the short-form screenplay structure
home.importModeHint: Keep existing files and organize later with a proposal
home.createFolderEmpty: New projects require an empty folder. Switch to Import for an existing folder.

studio.deleteProjectDesc: The project will be removed from Kenvo. Files on disk are not deleted.
